title: Freestanding 4-Arm Swing Towel Stand 49-Inch Solid Brass Assorted Free Standing Accessorie | Allied Brass
body_html:
Add flexible towel storage to your bathroom without wall mounting with this freestanding 4-arm swing towel stand, crafted from solid brass with a heavy base for stability.

  • Four pivoting arms: creates versatile hanging space and helps maximize storage
  • Freestanding design: place where you need it—no drilling required
  • Solid brass construction: designed for corrosion-free and rust-free performance
  • Stability + floor protection: heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping; felt pad helps prevent scratching
  • Coordinated look: part of the Soho collection with multiple designer finish options available

Specs

  • Collection: Soho
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting type: Freestanding
  • Overall size: 12-Inch L x 9.25-Inch W x 49-Inch H
  • Diameter: 1-Inch
  • Weight capacity: 20 lb
  • Product weight: 13.6 lb
  • Assembly required: Yes
  • Included: Towel stand
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.title: Soho Collection Free Standing 4 Pivoting Swing Arm Towel Stand
_previous.description: This elegantly designed free standing swing arm towel stand provides a convenient and stylish space to hang your favorite towels. Towel stand has 4 pivoting arms so that you can maximize your space. Large base is weighted to help prevent tipping. Towel stand is made of the finest solid brass materials so that it will not rust or corrode and is provided with one of our designer lifetime finishes.
